title: INSPECTION OF GEAR HOUSING / REPLACEMENT OF GEAR HOUSING

content.description: Control valve with pinion showing threaded shaft and valve assembly components

items: (a) Remove the control valve with pinion from the yoke housing.
(b) If necessary, replace the control valve assembly.

content.description: Steering rack assembly showing measurement points for runout inspection with dial indicator
Two detailed views showing removal and installation of rack housing oil seal using SST (Special Service Tool)

items: (a) Remove the oil seal with a screwdriver.
(b) Using SST, install the new oil seal.

content.description: Two detailed views showing removal and installation of cylinder housing oil seal using SST and spacer, with hammer installation method

items: (a) Using SST, drive out the seal.
(b) Using SST and a hammer, install a new oil seal.
• Place the spacer on the oil seal.
• Drive in the oil seal over the spacer until the round surface of SST is flush with housing surface.

content.text: 3. OIL SEAL AND BEARING FOR CONTROL VALVE HOUSING

content.description: Two detailed views showing removal of snap ring and removal of bearing and oil seal from control valve housing using brass bar

items: (b) Remove the bearing and oil seal with brass bar.
